what_happened: Research surfaced that task 142 (sapience_hooks_opt_out_default, status 'planned') already scopes an activation-wired, pre-claudeSettings vendor-hook-reinjection detector (Phase 2: new scripts/check-sapience-hooks.sh + a sapienceHooksGuard home.activation entry in modules/home/services/sapience.nix) that directly answers this task's scope item (c)/(d) 'between-activations detector' question, and that a separate nvim-repo check (verify-sapience-mcp.sh check (g), already committed under task 636) covers the manual/on-demand half. Added a 141->142 dependency edge via 'update-task-status.sh preflight 141 research <session> --depends-on-add=[142]' to serialize the shared sapience territory and avoid building a third, duplicate detector in the same file region.

Dispatch scope item (a) describes the enforced-key reset as converging the live settings.json at switch time but relying only on that -- empirically verified (synthetic jq run reproducing the 3-vendor-hook live state through the exact claudeSettings jq pipeline) that the existing enforced-key reduce step ALREADY fully resets .hooks to the source value on every home-manager switch (array replacement, not a shallow merge), so convergence-on-activation already holds with zero code change; the live ~/.claude/settings.json today (checked 2026-11-18) in fact carries only the one legitimate registration hook, confirming this. The only genuine code gap this task closes is the _SAPIENCE_NOTE enforced-key omission (FOURTH DEFECT).

Premise re-validation before planning caught that the research report's central routing finding was already stale: it described task 142's sapienceHooksGuard / check-sapience-hooks.sh detector as 'already planned, not yet implemented', but all four of 142's phases landed during this same orchestration run (commits f4db314..0f398a8). Confirmed on disk rather than inferred. Also confirmed the dispatch's 2026-11-14 three-vendor-hook live measurement no longer describes live state (live file carries exactly one Sapience hook; ~/.sapience/config.json .hooks is false), while the FOURTH DEFECT (_SAPIENCE_NOTE absent from the enforced-key array, live note text stale) is still present verbatim. Net effect: the plan could be scoped to the single real code gap with no speculative detector work and no rework risk against 142's landed design.
